aliases: County of Hainaut / 埃诺伯国

nameForms.name: County of Hainaut
nameForms.note: A Lotharingian imperial fief. From Richilde the county passed through the Baldwinid Flanders, Avesnes and Wittelsbach-Straubing lines before entering the Burgundian system under Philip the Good in 1433.
nameForms.noteCn: 洛林地区的帝国封建伯国。自里希尔德起，伯国先后经鲍德温家族佛兰德支系、阿韦讷家族与维特尔斯巴赫-施特劳宾支系统治，1433 年转入好人腓力治下的勃艮第体系。

holders.note: Held Hainaut in her own right; her rule's beginning is variously dated c.1050–1051, and she continued as regent/co-ruler for Baldwin II after 1071.
holders.noteCn: 以自身权利统治埃诺；其统治起点有 c.1050 与 1051 两说，1071 年后作为鲍德温二世的摄政/共治者继续执政。

holders.note: Co-ruler of Hainaut through his marriage to Richilde; his death in 1070 opened the Flemish succession crisis.
holders.noteCn: 因与里希尔德的婚姻而共治埃诺；1070 年去世引发佛兰德继承危机。

holders.note: Succeeded after his elder brother Arnulf III was killed at Cassel in 1071; later joined the First Crusade.
holders.noteCn: 1071 年其兄阿努尔夫三世在卡塞尔被杀后继任；后参加第一次十字军东征。

holders.note: Succeeded his father Baldwin II after his disappearance in Anatolia.
holders.noteCn: 父亲鲍德温二世在安纳托利亚失踪后继承。

holders.note: Known as 'the Builder'; consolidated the county.
holders.noteCn: 人称「建造者」，巩固了伯国。

holders.note: His marriage to Margaret I of Flanders reunited the Hainaut and Flemish lines; also Margrave of Namur (1189–1195) and Count of Flanders jure uxoris (1191–1194).
holders.noteCn: 与佛兰德的玛格丽特一世联姻，使埃诺与佛兰德两系重新合一；1189–1195 兼那慕尔藩侯，1191–1194 以妻权兼佛兰德伯爵。

holders.note: Baldwin VI of Hainaut / Baldwin IX of Flanders; became the first Latin Emperor of Constantinople in 1204.
holders.noteCn: 埃诺的鲍德温六世，即佛兰德的鲍德温九世；1204 年成为首位君士坦丁堡拉丁皇帝。

holders.note: Inherited as a child; ruled both Flanders and Hainaut until her death without surviving issue.
holders.noteCn: 幼年继承，同时统治佛兰德与埃诺，去世时无存活子嗣。

holders.note: Succeeded her sister Joan; her Avesnes–Dampierre dispute split the inheritance, with Hainaut passing to the Avesnes line.
holders.noteCn: 继承其姐让娜；阿韦讷与当皮埃尔之争使遗产分裂，埃诺转入阿韦讷一系。

holders.note: Inherited from his grandmother Margaret, completing the Avesnes transition; also Count of Holland and Zeeland from 1299.
holders.noteCn: 继承祖母玛格丽特，完成向阿韦讷家族的过渡；1299 年起兼荷兰与泽兰伯爵。

holders.note: Maintained the Hainaut–Holland–Zeeland union; father of Philippa, queen of Edward III of England.
holders.noteCn: 维持埃诺—荷兰—泽兰联合；爱德华三世王后菲利帕之父。

holders.note: Died without legitimate issue during the Frisian campaign in 1345.
holders.noteCn: 1345 年在弗里斯兰战役中阵亡，无合法子嗣。

holders.note: Her marriage to Emperor Louis IV carried Hainaut into the Wittelsbach dynasty; her son William III succeeded her.
holders.noteCn: 与皇帝路易四世的婚姻将埃诺带入维特尔斯巴赫家族；其子威廉三世继承伯国。

holders.note: Succeeded his mother Margaret II in 1356. After his incapacity in 1358, his brother Albert I governed as regent until William's death.
holders.noteCn: 1356 年继承母亲玛格丽特二世。1358 年失能后，其弟阿尔布雷希特一世摄政至威廉去世。

holders.note: Regent of Hainaut, Holland and Zeeland from 1358 during William III's incapacity; count in his own right only after 1389.
holders.noteCn: 自 1358 年起在威廉三世失能期间摄政埃诺、荷兰与泽兰；1389 年后方以自身权利成为伯爵。

holders.note: Succeeded Albert I; his death left his daughter Jacqueline as heiress.
holders.noteCn: 继承阿尔布雷希特一世；其去世使女儿雅克琳成为继承人。

holders.note: Her succession triggered a struggle with John of Bavaria and Philip the Good; she formally relinquished her counties in 1433.
holders.noteCn: 其继承引发与巴伐利亚的约翰及好人腓力的争夺；1433 年正式放弃诸伯国。

holders.note: Hainaut entered the Burgundian system under Philip the Good after Jacqueline's renunciation.
holders.noteCn: 雅克琳放弃权利后，埃诺在好人腓力治下转入勃艮第体系。
